children: SOL spot ETFs recorded $154 million in net inflows during last week’s trading days. According to ChainCatcher, Bitwise ETF BSOL led weekly inflows with $99.47 million, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $1.02 billion.

Grayscale’s SOL trust GSOL followed with $18.6 million in weekly net inflows, lifting its cumulative net inflows to $131 million. As of press time, SOL spot ETFs held $1.43 billion in total net assets, with a net asset ratio of 2.35% and cumulative net inflows of $1.34 billion.

title: SOL Spot ETFs Record $154 Million Net Inflow Last Week
